scope: native window recording of the built macOS player (documentation media)
sourceKind: native window capture of built player
claim: native window recording of the built macOS player — NOT previz, NOT generated. Every frame of both films originates from a macOS window capture of the shipped development build during the RFC-CX-015 native playtest session. No frame is generated, rendered offline, or re-created; the only added pixels are the locally authored Korean ASS caption cards and their scrim plates, burned in at encode time.

capture.scope: Explicit game-window ID only; no desktop capture. Window content 1280x800 plus a 64 px macOS titlebar and the transparent window shadow, which the crop removes.
capture.build: Unity 6000.5.6f1 development build, launched at 1280x800 with --m8-review-notes-diagnostic and an isolated save directory
capture.input: cliclick pointer only; synthetic key events do not reach the Unity Input System, so the keyboard path is delegated to PlayMode verification
capture.session: single continuous playtest session, three consecutive window takes; the window was moved/resized between takes, which is why seg-b carries a different frame size for the same 1280x800 content
capture.framerate: variable (screencapture): seg-a avg 51.07 fps, seg-b avg 48.61 fps, seg-c avg 47.56 fps

processing.cropDerivation: per-frame pixel scan of the capture: titlebar band = rows whose luminance>190 across >50% of the frame width; window left/right = first/last non-black column inside that band; window bottom = last non-black row inside the window columns. Stable on every sampled frame of all three sources.
processing.composition: The game window canvas is 1280x800 (16:10). M7's 1280x720 came from 16:9 previz sources, so reusing 720 here would have required either cropping UI away or a 1152x720 downscale plus 64 px pillarbox bars - a 10% resolution loss and a non-full-bleed frame. Cropping to the window content and encoding it 1:1 is sharper and full-bleed, so only the crop is applied.

overlay.styleBlock: [V4+ Styles] Base block reused verbatim from docs/media/concept-first-m7/gameplay-method.ass (NanumBarunGothic 34, PrimaryColour &H00DCE9EC, OutlineColour &H00161007, Outline 1.2, Alignment 7); only PlayResY was changed 720 -> 800 and the per-line \pos()/\fs overrides were rescaled by 1/0.9 for the taller 1:1 canvas.
overlay.cardPlacement: greybox 3D viewport region, measured in content pixels: x 26-554, y 121-390. Scrim plate 528x269 at (26,121). Card title \pos(58,147) fs50, description \pos(62,251) fs34. The viewport is a documented greybox placeholder (RFC-CX-015), so no live UI evidence is covered.
overlay.captionSource: locally authored Korean text; not generated typography
overlay.slug: \pos(596,24) fs20 in the empty right half of the header bar (header occupies y 20-110)
overlay.rangeLine: \pos(1248,24) fs20 \an9, right-aligned inside the header right edge (x 1253)
overlay.summaryCard: scrim 1280x576 at (0,116) - the band between the header bottom (110) and the toolbar top (700); head \pos(76,142) fs50, body y 251/307/362 fs34, boundary lines y 464/516/567 fs30

processing.cutPolicy: plain concat, no dissolves and no hold frames. Cut boundaries were placed by a 10 fps frame-difference scan of the cropped content; fully static stretches (seg-b 7-200 s and 207-234 s = time-scale list with pointer motion only) were excluded. Every boundary frame was rendered and visually confirmed to be live UI, not a black or mid-transition frame.

core-loop.shows: 관측 → 조작 → 확인 → 되돌림 loop, then 판독 → 검증 사본 보관 → 시간창 인용 as two stages

gameplay.shows: chronological: 셸·M5 오프닝 → 당직 인수 → 시간 눈금 → 판독·대조 → 자료 교체·인용

audioReason: The source is a silent native window recording (screencapture without audio) and no new sound was authored for this milestone. Unlike docs/media/concept-first-m7, which carries a locally authored ambience bed, these two films intentionally ship with no audio stream at all (nb_streams=1).
defectsVisibleInFootage: D-M9-17 repair is visible: the reader source picker reads 당직실 표준판 · 기록판 and 기록국 조위대장 · 장부 (media names) instead of the internal ids station-bureau-standard / watchlog-bureau — gameplay.mp4 120.3-141.3 s, core-loop.mp4 50.6-61.1 s.
Observed and not a defect (RFC-CX-015): the 눈금 선택기 reaches its lower rows by drag scroll, not wheel scroll — gameplay.mp4 54.3-60.8 s.
Observed and not a defect (RFC-CX-015): the 3D viewport is a greybox for the 회로 지도 / 판독기 nodes; the caption cards are deliberately placed over that greybox.
notMeasured: human playtest (n=0) — every input in this footage is agent-driven pointer automation
fun, immersion, pacing and the 25-minute session budget
frame rate / performance: the capture is variable-framerate and resampled to 24 fps, so it carries no performance claim
keyboard and controller equivalence (delegated to PlayMode verification; synthetic key events do not reach the Unity Input System)
audio design — the recording is silent and no sound was authored
회로 지도 정렬(−1/+1)·앵커·구획·근거 steps: completed before these three takes began, so they are not visible in this footage
프리뷰(diff 문장 + 되돌림 고지) → 확정 screen: exercised in the RFC-CX-015 session but not inside these three takes; what these films show is 판독 → 검증 사본 보관 → 시간창 인용 plus 되돌림/다시
G4/G5/G6/G7 runtime promotion and M7 concept resource promotion (runtimeApproved remains false)
limitations: agent-operated development build footage; no human or performance claim
no synthetic or generated frames in the recordings; the only added pixels are the burned-in Korean caption cards and their scrim plates
excerpt, not uninterrupted input evidence: dead stretches were removed and the three takes are joined by plain cuts
the two films share source material; core-loop.mp4 is a shorter re-cut of the seg-b/seg-c beats, not separate footage
window content is 16:10 (1280x800) and is encoded 1:1, so the output frame is 16:10 rather than the 16:9 used by docs/media/concept-first-m7
poster frames are extracted from the encoded films, so they inherit the burned-in overlay timeline
